model: Electric Bicycle for Adults, Folding Ebike w/20 Fat Tires, 750W Brushless Motor (Peak 850W)
description: The e-bike is equipped with a 750W brushless motor (850W peak power), ensuring a maximum speed of 30 mph and can handle inclines up to 18 degrees. Moreover, it offers 7-speed gearing, optimizing your ride on different terrains and conditions. This folding electric bicycle offers 4 riding modes, including pure electric mode, pedal assist mode, regular bike mode, and cruise mode. The pedal assist mode adjusts the speed intelligently based on your pedaling frequency, maintaining a steady 3-5 mph speed even uphill. And the cruise mode could be achieved by keeping the speed stable for 8 seconds. Boasting a 54V 13Ah lithium-ion battery, this bike ensures a maximum range of 20 miles in pure electric mode and up to 44 miles in EAS mode. It features BMS protection to prevent overcharging or discharging. Additionally, the battery can be quickly recharged in 5-6 hours and it can be removed from the e-bike, allowing for charging indoors. The electric bike is equipped with 50 x 7 cm/20" x 3" fat tires, providing exceptional grip and stability across various terrains, from rugged trails and snowy paths to city streets. Furthermore, it is enhanced with front fork suspension and dual disk brakes for reliable stopping power, ensuring a safe and stable riding experience. The handlebar, frame, and pedals can be easily folded, and the folding size is 35.8" x 16.5" x 28.7"/91 x 42 x 73 cm (L x W x H), allowing you to effortlessly carry or store it in confined spaces or on public transport. It is ideal for daily commuting, leisurely weekend rides, and exhilarating off-road adventures. And the saddle height can be adjusted for maximum comfort. The city commuter e-bike is equipped with dual disk brakes for reliable stopping, a smart LCD display for monitoring battery levels, distance traveled, and speed control, along with a bell, a bright headlight and rear light to enhance visibility. Other than that, there is a rear storage rack for attaching a basket, bringing convenience for carrying items. Product Description Unleash the Thrill of Urban Exploration and Off-Road Adventures! Our folding electric bike is portable, compact, and space-saving, meeting your needs for daily commuting, leisurely weekend rides, and exhilarating off-road adventures. Boasting a powerful 750W brushless motor with an impressive peak power of 850W, this bike ensures exhilarating speeds of up to 30 mph and effortless navigation of 18-degree slopes, while the 7-speed gears and 4 riding modes offer versatility to tackle any terrain with ease. Thanks to its 50 x 7 cm/20" x 3" fat tires, coupled with front fork suspension for shock absorption and dual disk brakes for safe stopping, this bike could conquer any terrain, such as snow roads, mountain roads, sand roads, city roads, and more. The high-capacity 54V 13Ah battery offers a maximum range of 20 miles in full electric mode and extends up to 44 miles with pedal assist, empowering you to go further with confidence.
